attributes.name: Mind's Eye Blade
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+2; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d4. If the check is to defeat a monster, if the monster is defeated, you may examine the top card of any location.

On your combat check, when you would discard or recharge this card for a power on your character or role card, you may shuffle it into your deck instead.
